$comment: Verdicts on upstream PRs, consumed by scripts/check-upstream.mjs.
Any open upstream PR missing from this file is reported as NEEDS TRIAGE and
raises the weekly alert. Add a verdict here to silence it.
The human-readable rationale lives in ROADMAP.md § Harvesting from upstream — keep both in sync.
verdict: harvest = queued for SKILL.md | harvested = port complete
later = revisit when relevant | skip = decided against | noise = generated clone output
